declarations.docstring: The left-derived functor of an additive functor is additive in every degree.
Deriving the sum of two natural transformations agrees with the sum of their derived transformations.
Mapping homological complexes sends the sum of natural transformations to the sum of the induced transformations.
The functor assigning projective resolutions is additive.
The morphism assigned to a sum of linear maps is the sum of the assigned morphisms.
The morphism assigned to a composite of linear maps is the composite of the assigned morphisms.
The identity linear map is assigned the identity morphism.
An isomorphism between the value of the displayed object construction on a binary biproduct and the biproduct of its values.
An isomorphism between the displayed object construction on a finite biproduct and the biproduct of the corresponding functor values.
An isomorphism between the displayed construction on a finite dependent function module and the biproduct of its values on the factors.
An isomorphism between the displayed construction on a product of two modules and the biproduct of its values on the factors.
An additive homomorphism from linear maps to morphisms between values of the displayed object construction.
The objectwise morphism assigned to a sum of linear maps is the sum of the assigned morphisms.
The objectwise morphism assigned to a composite of linear maps is the composite of the assigned morphisms.
The objectwise morphism assigned to the identity linear map is the identity morphism.
The objectwise morphism assigned to the zero linear map is zero.
